label: preparing
what: Likely a community supper and service-acknowledgement gathering in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, presented to me as a routine lighting inspection. Builder coordinates the hall and asks neighbour to escort me for the acknowledgement; neighbour collects food contributions and agrees to the escort; innkeeper coordinates hospitality. Baker and freight appear knowingly to help with food and delivery logistics, though their precise roles are less certain. It may be an appreciation event for me, but whose service is being recognised is not confirmed. There is no reliable evidence of a bridge or port project, or that secretary knows of the undisclosed purpose rather than merely managing my approved appointment.
